note: Stage 2: NVIDIA OneTrust preference centre after "Manage Settings". Toggles already off (US); has Decline All. Stage 2. Labels: the 'NVIDIA Preference Center' header link (1) is 'settings' because autoconsent's regex says so (§2e step 4; the labeller cannot tell it from a real settings link; the chooser prefers reject here, so the decision is unaffected); the accordion header buttons (5, 6, 8, 10) are 'other', toggles are only the three switches; 'Save and Accept' (13) is on the §0 allow-list so 'save'. Decision: 'Decline All' (12) is reject, §2f.1 beats save-with-toggles.
